propositions: Closed bugs lacking close_class must be backfilled with values inferred from structural signals only: REVERT of STATUS/COMMITS→regression, plan-review BLOCK→plan_defect, gate_error_v1→env_integration, otherwise→undetermined.
Backfilled classifications must be written to .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified, segregating them from authoritative close_class values.
The backfill script must be idempotent: skip any bug already present in the artifact and any bug whose reduced state[close_class] is already set.
REVERT signals must filter for substantive reverts (target_event_type=STATUS or COMMITS), excluding reverts of COMMENT/LINK events.
plan-review BLOCK verdicts must be detected via all_review_results; gate_error_v1 records must be detected via raw event-file scan of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json files.
